Filed at P3 under the letter of category 12 (closest literal fit — a captured-artifact-vs-true-rendered-state pixel mismatch, no 4xx/error/i18n/overlap/aria/numeric-data category applies) consistent with this audit's established literal-reading discipline (round-1/round-2 practice, see E-007).
